comment: Pinned OpenFlux core used by opffk, built and published by the node-release workflow of the pinned repository. URLs and SHA-256 verified against that release on 2026-10-24. installer and backend refuse any binary whose hash differs.

core.fork_note: This fork build adds --egress-proxy / EgressProxy (SOCKS5/HTTP egress for the l4 exit) on top of upstream node-v1.3.1's source (commit c9076e7). The patch lives on the opffk-egress branch of upiok/OpenFlux.

upstream_verify.method: SHA256SUMS published with the release; the fork's node-release workflow verifies its build against deploy/node-install.sh pins (same values as the local reproducible build used to write them)
